_description: Preview camera and lighting tuning. Reloaded whenever the outfit manager is reopened. Position values use game world units.
targetScanRadius__description: NPC scan radius on Select Target. GOE ray selection is not limited by this value.
visualScalePercent__description: Visual character size in preview. This changes only the preview camera, not actor scale, equipment, or save data. Suggested range: 70 to 140.
cameraDistance__description: Base camera distance from the character. Lower values appear closer. Suggested range: 160 to 360.
cameraRight__description: Horizontal camera position relative to the character. Adjust in steps of 10 to 20.
cameraHeight__description: Vertical camera position relative to the character. Adjust in steps of 10 to 20.
cameraFov__description: Preview camera field of view. Suggested range: 55 to 80.
cameraYawOffsetDegrees__description: Horizontal camera angle offset in degrees. Suggested range: -25 to 25.
cameraPitchDegrees__description: Vertical camera angle offset in degrees. Adjust in steps of 2 to 4.
_previewLightingDescription: Positions for two temporary preview lights. They are not saved to the world and do not modify vanilla light records.
keyLightForward__description: Key light forward position relative to the character. Suggested range: 80 to 260.
keyLightRight__description: Key light horizontal position. Adjust in steps of 20 to 40.
keyLightHeight__description: Key light height relative to the character. Suggested range: 60 to 180.
fillLightForward__description: Fill light forward position, used to soften shadows opposite the key light.
fillLightRight__description: Fill light horizontal position, usually opposite the key light.
fillLightHeight__description: Fill light height. A position slightly above the key light produces a softer full-body outline.
_nightLowerLightDescription: Outdoors from 19:00 to 06:30, an extra low fill light improves shadows below the waist. It is not created during daytime or indoors.
nightLowerLightForward__description: Night lower light forward position. Suggested range: 200 to 300.
nightLowerLightRight__description: Night lower light horizontal position. Zero places it directly in front of the character.
nightLowerLightHeight__description: Night lower light height above the character's feet. Suggested range: 20 to 80.
_colorAndRangeDescription: This release uses temporary vanilla white-light references. Color temperature and physical range are not exposed because modifying shared vanilla records would affect other lights in the game.
